mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_cod AS productCod, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_img AS productImg, p.product_file_path AS productFilePath, ph.new_price AS lastedUpdatePrice, ph.changed_at AS lastedChangedAt FROM product AS p LEFT JOIN product_price_history ph ON p.product_id = ph.product_id AND ph.changed_at = ( SELECT MAX(changed_at) FROM product_price_history WHERE product_id = p.product_id ) WHERE p.product_Registration_status = 1 AND p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
